catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class binds one scalar automatic measurement of an oscilloscope: cap.measure.voltage.v1 declares instrument.dmm, instrument.smu and sensor; cap.sensing.read.v1 declares sensor, sensor.imu and sensor.force_torque, not instrument. The action reads one :MEASure:<item>? scalar from the scope's current measurement source.

No catalogue class starts continuous acquisition on an instrument: cap.process.run.v1 is a process recipe and cap.device.self_test.v1 is a self-test. The action sends the native :RUN and reports the acquisition completion percentage.
No catalogue class arms one acquisition on an instrument; cap.measure.spectrum.v1 is a spectrum sweep. The action sends :SINGle and reports the acquisition completion percentage.

No catalogue class auto-configures an instrument's vertical, timebase and trigger settings; cap.device.configure.v1 is a named-parameter write. The action sends :AUToscale and returns the channel-1 scale and offset read back.

No catalogue class stops an oscilloscope acquisition; cap.motion.stop.v1 is motion-specific and the native :STOP is this instrument's safe state. The action is the safe-state stop and reports the acquisition completion percentage.

notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/labs/jovanmarkov96__keysight-dsox1200-control --backend fake; evidence is contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card proposes a ScpiDriver, but this package is a direct Driver over keysight_dsox1200.instrument:DSOX1200 with a native.py factory, because every channel command embeds the channel number and is assembled at run time, so a fixed command table cannot reproduce the lines the device receives (G7). The fake is an in-memory stand-in for the upstream class, not a transcript; every number in fake.py is marked as a placeholder and none is used as a Fact or a Limit. Covered: identity; channel-1 display, coupling, probe, scale, offset and invert; timebase mode, scale and position; trigger source, level, slope and sweep; acquisition type, count, points, sample rate and completion; the scalar automatic measurements; run, single, autoscale and a safe-state stop. NOT COVERED: the waveform array (capture_waveform/capture_all_channels return a time array and a voltage array from the :WAVeform:DATA? binary block), the PNG screenshot, markers, FFT, DVM and the GUI. The probe ratio, invert, timebase mode and position, trigger slope and sweep, acquisition count and points are readable state but not writable: cap.device.configure.v1 is the only writable-state tool and the MCP projection bounds one tool to 2048 bytes. The vertical scale and offset, timebase scale and trigger level are operator_required, so they are refused with MHS.SAFETY.LIMITS_UNSET until the site overlay supplies a range; site-limits.example.json is an example overlay. The package is model-authored and unreviewed (reviewed_by null), the hardware backend was never started, and nothing here ran on an instrument. gate.digest is the digest the check printed (the report without its clock); check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
